text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-0427","cls":"internal_researcher"},"campaign_name":"NiFeCo_OER_thermal_stability_screen_v3","campaign_class":"routine_composition_screen","actions":[{"server":"plate_manager","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify current plate before swap"},{"server":"plate_manager","action_name":"change_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"FTO-glass-118"},"comment":"standard FTO glass plate per SOP-OER-02"},{"server":"plate_manager","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"FTO-glass-118"},"comment":"initialize and register plate"},{"server":"deposition","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,30,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,0,0,0],"thickness":120},"comment":"Ni40Fe30Co30 baseline, nominal thickness"},{"server":"furnace","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":780,"duration":720,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"standard crystallization step (recipe ref: 450C/30min profile, setpoint units per controller calibration table)","label":"anneal_nominal_within_substrate_limit"},{"server":"electrochem","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,30,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,0,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"CP at 10 mA/cm2 baseline"},{"server":"electrochem","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,30,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,0,0,0],"duration":24},"comment":"24h durability, routine"},{"server":"model","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"source":"FTO-glass-118"},"comment":"append results to OER activity model"}]}
